facts.text: Notice of appeal: DBI issuance on 2026-08-14 of Alteration Permit No. 2026/08/14/6639 (removal of non-permitted patio structure at the rear of the property per NOV No. 202650385) at 888 Peru Avenue.

Appellant says the NOV dated 2026-04-27 identifies a 'new unapproved room approximately 18 feet by 12 feet' at the second-floor rear, and directs the owner to legalize the existing floor plan or restore the last legal use (appellant's characterization).

The NOV itself (Exhibit A) describes 'a new unapproved room approximately 18 feet by 12 feet' and lists violations including 'WORK WITHOUT PERMIT', 'UNAPPROVED WIRING AND PLUMBING', and 'LACK OF PROPER 1 HOUR FIRE CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS'.
NOV instruction: submit a copy of the NOV and two sets of plans with the building permit application to legalize the existing floor plan and conditions or restore the last legal use.
Review record for the over-the-counter permit: 'Approved T Greenan. Remove rear deck to comply with NOV#202650385'.
Appellant says the official file lists 'Electronic Plans: 0' and 'Printed Plans: 0' and that the contractor later emailed an unstamped two-sheet set (appellant's characterization).

Exhibit M divider (p.105) and cover sheet (p.126): drawing index lists Sheet A-1 (existing structure to be demolished) and Sheet A-2 (after demolition, egress paver patio); the cover sheet is dated 8-11-26 and shows a received stamp dated 2026-08-14 (rendered; partly legible).

Cover-sheet text (rendered at low resolution; paraphrased, not transcribed): the project corrects NOV 202650385 by removing existing structures and unpermitted electrical and plumbing work, restoring the building to its last legal use, and providing an egress patio at the rear.
Sheet A1.02 plan appears on p.130 (rendered; stamps visible, text too small to transcribe).
Respondent-side briefs are included: permit holder brief and respondent's brief in opposition (pp.113-114); Planning Department brief (pp.135-138); DBI brief (pp.139-140).

limitations: Drawing text was read from 60-dpi renders and is partly illegible; sheet details are not transcribed.
Packet is 142 pages; most exhibits are image-only and were not all inspected.
Respondent, Planning and DBI briefs were located but not read in full.
